candidates.desc: In a cartoon park a big goose steals a family's picnic basket; while her parents cower behind the fence, a small red-haired girl clenches her fists, marches straight at the goose, stares it down and takes the basket back - then her parents lift her up like a champion with a trophy.

In a cartoon winter scene, a boy steps off a dock onto a frozen lake past a warning sign; the ice cracks under his boot and breaks into floes while he wobbles in panic, until his friend pulls him back to the dock and they sit catching their breath.
A young man stands at a bathroom sink about to eat a grape when a hidden partner jumps out and yells, making him freeze wide-eyed with his mouth open in shock.

Backstage in the dark wings, a young musician with an acoustic guitar peeks through the curtain at the bright stage. He gulps water, breathes with wide anxious eyes and a hand on his chest, and when the stage manager points him on, he steels himself and walks out in front of the crowd.

Two hikers stumble out of a snowstorm into a stone mountain hut; one bolts the heavy wooden door, hangs up the wet jackets and watches the storm rage outside the window, then they feed the log stove and sit with steaming mugs, sighing with relief that they are fine now.

A woman with a tote bag walks alone through a dim underground parking garage, hears something, calls out 'Who's there?', lights her phone flashlight, then presses her back against a pillar with wide eyes and both hands clamped over her mouth.

A drone looks straight down at turquoise open sea. In the middle of the frame one woman in a dark swimsuit floats face down on the surface with her arms stretched out to the sides and her legs together, completely still. All around her, filling the whole picture, dozens of large sharks swim in every direction, some passing directly under her body, others crossing within a metre of her hands and feet. The camera holds and slowly drifts; the sharks keep circling and criss-crossing around her and she never moves.

Two young women walk through a dark haunted-house corridor at a funfair, hung with fake cobwebs and strings of coloured lights. They cling to each other with their eyes wide and their mouths open, edging forward. A masked figure in a white mask appears in the corridor behind them and they bolt, running towards the camera through a black curtain. They burst out into the daylight of the fairground, still gripping each other's hands, panting with their hands pressed to their chests.

A green jungle with hanging vines and sunbeams coming through the leaves. A young woman with long box braids, in a lime crop top and white linen trousers, sits in a white rope hammock with her hand on half a mango on a leaf. She freezes with wide, frightened eyes, staring up at a bright green snake coiled around a branch above her head as it moves slowly. She pulls her hand back, presses it to her chest and grimaces nervously.

In a log cabin with a burning wood stove and snow outside the window, a bearded man in a navy jumper, cream trousers and dark socks stands on a wooden chair, gripping a straw broom and staring down in fright. On the wooden floor below, a small white mouse moves around beside a knocked-over mug. At the end the man lifts the broom up high with both hands and holds it upright in front of him. A sheepskin rug and a metal bucket of firewood are in the room.
